motion.name: capsule-hover

components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-action-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.65rem 1.1rem; background: var(--gold); color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-action-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--cyan); } .ds-action-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-action-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Secondary Text Action
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { color: var(--cyan); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Active Route
components.description: Indicates the section nearest the viewport center.
components.html: The project
components.css: .ds-route { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; color: var(--paper); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-route--project { --route-color: var(--cyan); } .ds-route:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-route.ds-route--active { border-color: var(--cyan); background: var(--orbit); color: var(--paper); } .ds-route-marker { order: 1; width: 0.6rem; height: 0.6rem; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--route-color); transition: order 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 280ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-route.ds-route--active .ds-route-marker { order: -1; transform: scale(1.2); } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cyan); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Status Capsule
components.description: Makes project or gameplay progress explicit.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2rem; align-items: center; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; background: var(--violet); color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Project Story Panel
components.description: Light reading surface for the project narrative.
components.html:
Space equipment has stories beyond its mission.

Discoveries and legacy connect the stories.

Stories span the Moon, Mars, and deep space.
components.css: .ds-story-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.05fr) minmax(18rem, 0.75fr); gap: 4rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 6rem 3rem 9rem; background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }

components.name: Gameplay Panel
components.description: Contrasting surface for the rules-in-development preview.
components.html:
How to play

The tabletop concept is taking shape, but the rules are not final yet.
components.css: .ds-gameplay-panel { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.9fr) minmax(18rem, 1fr); column-gap: 5rem; row-gap: 1rem; border-radius: 1.75rem; padding: 8rem 3rem 9rem; background: var(--orbit); color: var(--paper); }

narrative.overview:
The homepage frames space-exploration stories in a quiet, luminous night sky. A near-black violet field and restrained star points establish the atmosphere; pale reading panels make the project and team easy to scan, while a cosmic-blue gameplay section gives the rules preview its own clear place. The existing Gabarito typography keeps the presentation warm and approachable without weakening the dark, archival mood.

The visual language is made from color, spacing, capsule navigation, and alternating section surfaces. Preserve the project's explicit in-development status and factual storytelling focus; the design presents an unfinished tabletop concept, not established gameplay.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black violet frame with a subtle, repeating star-point texture.
Starlight reading panels alternating with a cosmic-blue gameplay panel.
Gabarito headlines and readable, open body copy.
Capsule links and status markers use cyan, violet, and warm gold as focused accents.

rules.name: The Night-Sky Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep the near-black violet field as the page's continuous frame; use the star points as a subtle texture behind, not in place of, readable content.

rules.name: The Luminous Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep long-form project and team copy on starlight surfaces, reserving cosmic blue for the gameplay preview.

dos: Do use the documented night, starlight, blue, violet, cyan, and gold palette roles.
Do keep Gabarito Variable across display and body text, with the established tight heading tracking and readable body measure.
Do preserve capsule interaction markers, visible keyboard focus, and the contrast between reading panels and gameplay.
Do keep the project and gameplay status explicit while rules remain in development.
donts: Don't weaken the starlight reading surfaces by placing long-form copy directly over the star texture.
Don't present unconfirmed setup, play sequence, or goals as established rules.
Don't let decorative star points compete with the content or become navigation.
